AAT.caption: Properties
AAT.doc: You can send users properties with their values.
AAT.name: properties

AAU.caption: One Time
AAU.doc: If you set the same user property multiple times, the next event will use the new value of that property. If you want to set a user property only once, set this field to `true`.
AAU.name: isOnce

AAV.caption: Sending user information _________________________________________________________
AAV.doc: An ID alone might not be enough to work out which user is who within PostHog. That's why it's useful to send over more metadata of the user. At minimum, we recommend sending the email property, which is also what we use to display in PostHog.
AAV.name: info

AAW.caption: Note _________________________________________________________
AAW.doc: You can make this call on every page view to make sure this information is up-to-date. Alternatively, you can also do this whenever a user first appears (after signup) or when they change their information.
AAW.name: more_info
